name: Alexander Ullom
bio: Alexander Ullom is an American filmmaker, best known for directing the horror film It Ends (2025).

credits.title: 4X4: The Event
credits.overview: Eight contestants enter an illegal sensory-assault livestream where they must kill or be killed using only what they can order online.

credits.title: It Ends
credits.overview: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. credits.title: Chipped
credits.overview: The nightmare-portrait of a young man dealing with anxiety, panic attacks, and paranoia surrounding the irrational fear of people coming to take his teeth while he sleeps.

credits.title: Joining the Birds
credits.overview: A young woman spots her mother at a dance club and struggles to find a way to connect, in this meditative short from FSU filmmaker Carrie Carusone.

credits.title: Quite Like You
credits.overview: During a tropical storm, adolescent sisters Camille and Tal are left to their own supervision. Trying to pass time, Camille aches to understand her older sister's change in behavior.
